description:
Update non-secret channel configuration — enable/disable, default agent, allowed senders, outbound policy, etc.

Allowed fields per channel:
- email: enabled, allowedSenders (string[]), inboundAddress, allowOutboundEmail, allowedOutboundRecipients, requireOutboundApproval. defaultAgentId is legacy and ignored by email routing.
- slack: enabled, defaultAgentId, defaultChannelId (Slack channel ID used to route inbound mentions when one Slack team is shared)
- whatsapp: enabled, defaultAgentId
- signal: enabled, defaultAgentId
- telegram: enabled, defaultAgentId, botUsername, allowedChatIds

Secret fields (botToken, signingSecret, accessToken, webhookSecret) are REJECTED by the
external API — connect those via the Settings → Channels UI (OAuth flows encrypt at rest).

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

allow_outbound_email.description: Allow agents to send email replies and new outbound email (email only)

allowed_outbound_recipients.description: Allowed recipient patterns for outbound email, e.g. "*", "*@example.com", or "person@example.com" (email only)

allowed_senders.description: Sender whitelist (email only; empty = allow all)

default_agent_id.description: Agent ID to handle inbound messages

default_channel_id.description: Slack channel ID to bind this workspace to, used for inbound mention routing when one Slack team is shared

inbound_address.description: Inbound email address (email only; usually auto-generated)

require_outbound_approval.description: Require approval before every outbound email delivery (email only)

name: configure_channel
